trials.seeded_defect: Check-then-act race (TOCTOU): Acquire inspects m.leases[itemID] under RLock, drops RLock before hook/yield, and acquires Lock to overwrite m.leases[itemID] without re-checking whether another goroutine acquired a non-expired lease in the gap.
required_detection_elements: Identifies RLock-to-Lock gap / TOCTOU race across concurrent Acquire calls
Identifies missing re-check under exclusive Lock (or holding Lock across check-and-insert)

trials.seeded_defect: Proof validator checks git merge-base --is-ancestor target_commit_sha HEAD without verifying HEAD == target_commit_sha or validating canonical 40-char hex SHA format, allowing unverified trailing commits and symbolic ref values like HEAD to pass.
required_detection_elements: Identifies that merge-base --is-ancestor permits unverified trailing commits after target_commit_sha
Identifies lack of exact HEAD == target_commit_sha or canonical 40-hex SHA validation

trials.seeded_defect: resolveSafeExportPath checks !candidate.startsWith(root) without a trailing path separator or path.relative containment check, allowing sibling-prefix directory escapes such as ../exports-secrets/token.txt when baseDir is /tmp/.../exports.
required_detection_elements: Identifies missing trailing path.sep / path.relative boundary check in startsWith(root)
trials.failing_test_name: repro sibling-prefix directory escape bypasses startsWith check

trials.seeded_defect: verify_artifact_digest wraps manifest parsing and key lookup in except Exception and returns True, causing corrupt JSON, missing manifest files, or missing artifact keys to fail open.
required_detection_elements: Identifies broad except Exception returning True (fail-open verification bypass)
Recommends returning False or raising explicit verification error on missing/corrupt manifest or missing entry
